classification.difficultyReason: Match opposite sides and angles, rearrange the sine rule for sine theta and apply inverse sine. The existing angle and side sizes exclude an admissible supplementary solution.

content.prompt: Find the value of $\theta$, correct to the nearest degree.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base, 76 degrees at the lower-left vertex and theta at the lower-right vertex. The left side is 10 and the opposite sloping side is 12.
spec.mathematics: sin(theta)/10 = sin(76 degrees)/12. No units are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown theta are visible.

answer.worked:
Apply the sine rule and take reciprocals:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{10}{\sin\theta}&=\frac{12}{\sin76^\circ}\\\frac{\sin\theta}{10}&=\frac{\sin76^\circ}{12}\\\sin\theta&=\frac{10\sin76^\circ}{12}\\\theta&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{10\sin76^\circ}{12}\right)\\\theta&\approx54^\circ.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Inverted triangle with theta at the upper-left vertex and 63 degrees at the upper-right vertex. The side opposite 63 degrees is 8; the side opposite theta is 5.
spec.mathematics: sin(theta)/5 = sin(63 degrees)/8. No units are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown theta are visible.

answer.worked:
Apply the sine rule and take reciprocals:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{5}{\sin\theta}&=\frac{8}{\sin63^\circ}\\\frac{\sin\theta}{5}&=\frac{\sin63^\circ}{8}\\\sin\theta&=\frac{5\sin63^\circ}{8}\\\theta&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{5\sin63^\circ}{8}\right)\\\theta&\approx34^\circ.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with theta at the left vertex and 85 degrees at the top vertex. The side opposite theta is 23 and the side opposite 85 degrees is 25.
spec.mathematics: sin(theta)/23 = sin(85 degrees)/25. No units are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown theta are visible.

answer.worked:
Apply the sine rule and take reciprocals:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{23}{\sin\theta}&=\frac{25}{\sin85^\circ}\\\frac{\sin\theta}{23}&=\frac{\sin85^\circ}{25}\\\sin\theta&=\frac{23\sin85^\circ}{25}\\\theta&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{23\sin85^\circ}{25}\right)\\\theta&\approx66^\circ.\end{align*}$$
